reason: Working source entrypoint registers genuine GA4 Admin API discovery and property/web-stream provisioning alongside local tracking/configuration and optional registry tools; Data API reporting belongs only to a documented companion.

tools.name: get_ga4_auth_setup_instructions
tools.description: Return GCP/GA auth steps. Prefer service account if gcloud ADC shows 'This app is blocked'.
tools.behavior: Return static service-account, ADC, API-enablement and companion-server setup instructions.

tools.name: list_ga_account_summaries
tools.description: List GA account summaries and child properties (read-only Admin API).
tools.behavior: Call Admin API list_account_summaries and return account and child property summaries.
notes: Handler caps limit at 50; no exposed numeric bounds.

tools.name: provision_ga4_property
tools.description:
Create a new GA4 property for a project under a GA account.
account_id: numeric id only (e.g. 12345678) or accounts/12345678.
tools.behavior: Normalize account ID and create a Property with display name project_name - environment, account parent, timezone and currency. Blank account_id uses GA4_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT_ID.
notes: Blank timezone/currency fall back to GA4_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE/GA4_DEFAULT_CURRENCY or hardcoded defaults; account normalization strips all nondigits.

tools.name: create_web_data_stream
tools.description:
Create a web data stream for a GA4 property. Returns measurement_id (G-XXXXXXXX).
property_id: numeric or properties/<id>.
tools.behavior: Create a WEB_DATA_STREAM under the normalized property with stream name and website default URI; return measurement ID.
notes: Handler accepts numeric property ID or properties/<numeric ID>; website URL has no local format validation.

tools.name: render_ga4_gtag_snippet
tools.description: Return HTML gtag snippet for a measurement ID.
tools.behavior: Generate the standard HTML gtag.js loader and configuration block.
notes: Measurement ID is stripped then validated against G-[A-Z0-9]+ in implementation, not input schema.

tools.name: inject_ga4_gtag_into_file
tools.description:
Inject or update GA4 gtag in a local HTML/layout file (absolute path recommended).
Set dry_run=true to preview without writing.
tools.behavior: Read a local file; replace GA4 placeholder, update an existing gtag ID, insert before closing head, or append; write changes unless dry_run.
notes: Measurement ID must match G-[A-Z0-9]+ after trimming; dry_run returns actions and size rather than full updated source.

tools.name: render_ga4_nextjs_component
tools.description:
Return a Next.js client component (next/script) for GA4.
mode: env (read NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID) or inline (embed id).
consent_gated: only load gtag after localStorage cookie consent is accepted.
tools.behavior: Generate a Next.js next/script client component, suggested path and env line; optionally gate loading on cookie_consent accepted in localStorage and consent events.
notes: mode is a plain string schema but handler restricts it to env or inline; measurement ID must match G-[A-Z0-9]+.

tools.name: scaffold_ga4_nextjs_tracking
tools.description:
Scaffold GA4 for a Next.js app: write GoogleAnalytics.tsx, wire layout.tsx,
and set NEXT_PUBLIC_GA_MEASUREMENT_ID in .env.local (when mode=env).
web_root must be the Next.js package root (directory containing package.json).
tools.behavior: Require package.json and existing layout; generate GoogleAnalytics.tsx, patch import/body usage, and upsert .env.local when mode=env, unless dry_run.
notes: mode is a plain string schema but handler restricts it to env or inline; measurement ID must match G-[A-Z0-9]+.
If layout has no body tag or usage placeholder, layout is unchanged but component/env can still be written.

tools.name: save_project_ga4_config
tools.description: Write .ga4.config.json in a project root for agents and humans to reference later.
tools.behavior: Write .ga4.config.json under an existing directory with trimmed metadata and normalized numeric property ID; include arbitrary extra dictionary if truthy.
notes: extra intentionally accepts arbitrary nested JSON values; no extra model exists. Property normalization errors and filesystem errors are not caught.

tools.name: provision_project_ga4_setup
tools.description:
End-to-end: create property + web stream, optionally save .ga4.config.json and wire tracking.
tracking_mode: none | html | nextjs | auto (auto uses detect_tracking_stack when project_dir set).
inject_html_path used for html mode (or explicit path). scaffold_nextjs_web_root for nextjs mode.
If registry_slug is set and GA4_LAUNCHER_REGISTRY_* env is configured, syncs analytics.ga4 metadata.
tools.behavior: Create property then web stream; optionally write config, detect/apply HTML or Next.js tracking, and sync launcher registry metadata.
notes: nextjs_dry_run affects only Next.js scaffolding; property/stream provisioning, config writing, HTML injection and registry sync still occur.
No rollback if stream creation fails after property creation; returned ok may remain true when optional wiring/sync results fail.
tracking_mode has no schema enum or handler rejection of unknown modes; auto uses filesystem heuristics. Explicit inject_html_path triggers injection even outside html mode.

tools.name: scan_local_ga4_configs
tools.behavior: Walk specified roots or ~/projects for .ga4.config.json, skipping common dependency/VCS directories and applying max_depth; return sorted metadata inventory.
notes: Empty list and null both use default roots; directories at depth >= max_depth are not processed.

tools.name: list_projects_needing_ga4
tools.description: Launcher registry projects missing local config and/or registry analytics.ga4 metadata.
tools.behavior: Read launcher registry, filter candidates, inspect local configs and registry measurement IDs, return missing-both or partial gaps and tracking stack hints.
notes: Requires configured existing launcher registry; limit clamped to 1..100 before gap filtering.

tools.name: detect_project_tracking_stack
tools.description: Recommend html vs nextjs wiring for a project directory.
tools.behavior: Inspect existing project directory and candidate web roots for App Router layouts or HTML entrypoints; recommend nextjs, html or unknown.

tools.name: get_analytics_monitoring_companion_guide
tools.description: How to pair this provision server with official read-only analytics-mcp for reports.
tools.behavior: Return a static dual-server workflow and example configuration for separate official analytics-mcp reporting.
notes: Documentation only: no run_report, realtime or other Data API reporting implemented by this server.

tools.name: get_ga4_integration_status
tools.description: Report optional launcher registry and keymaster hook availability (graceful when unset).
tools.behavior: Inspect optional launcher registry and Keymaster environment paths and return availability plus environment documentation.
notes: Keymaster hooks inspect paths and provide composition hints; no Keymaster credential ingestion API is called.

tools.name: list_registry_projects_for_ga4
tools.description: List launcher registry projects with .ga4.config.json and .keymaster hints when registry env is set.
tools.behavior: Read optional launcher registry, apply case-insensitive filter and enrich projects with config, Keymaster bootstrap and web-root hints.
notes: Requires GA4_LAUNCHER_REGISTRY_JSON or LAUNCHER_REGISTRY_JSON existing file; limit clamped to 1..100.

tools.name: resolve_project_for_ga4
tools.description: Resolve registry slug and/or filesystem path for GA4 provisioning (paths, website_url, agent hints).
tools.behavior: Resolve registry slug and/or local directory; read GA4 config and Keymaster bootstrap metadata, suggest web roots and URL, emit agent integration hints.
notes: At least one nonblank slug/project_dir required in implementation, not schema.

tools.name: sync_ga4_to_launcher_registry
tools.description: Write GA4 metadata to launcher registry project.analytics.ga4 (requires writable env).
tools.behavior: Find launcher registry project by slug; overwrite analytics.ga4 metadata with timestamp and save registry JSON updating updated_at.
notes: Tool always registered; action requires existing registry env and GA4_LAUNCHER_REGISTRY_WRITABLE set to 1,true,yes. Measurement ID must match G-[A-Z0-9]+. Property ID only trimmed, not validated.
Source review only; no tools/list, upstream execution or live requests. Source supplied without .git; supplied revision is authoritative.
All 18 @mcp.tool registrations are unconditional. ga4://workflow is a resource, excluded from tool count. Separate analytics-mcp and Keymaster tools mentioned in docs/hints are not registered here.

Published console entrypoint ga4-provision-mcp resolves to ga4_provision_mcp.server:main and uses MCP SDK 1 FastMCP, stdio transport. README documents uv sync; uv.lock pins mcp 1.28.1 and provides the compatible MCP 1 install path. Install/runtime not executed in this extraction.

Schema reconstructed from annotations/defaults: no Pydantic/TypedDict request models or injected Context parameters; Optional dict/list nullability retained, arbitrary Any dict values preserved. Docstrings are complete tool descriptions; colon parameter prose is not a Field description or schema constraint.
Credentials use AnalyticsAdminServiceClient application-default credentials. Optional integrations only read/write local registry and inspect Keymaster files; no Data API calls.

review.method: Independently compared all 18 decorated server signatures/defaults/docstrings. Read Admin API provisioning, stream creation and local snippet/Next.js/config/inventory handlers; distinguished static guidance and registry helpers from implemented collection setup. Checked the documented uv lock installation path.
